evidence_snippets: Extreme Persistent Disk ( pd-extreme ) Offers consistently high performance for both random access workloads and bulk throughput.
SSD (Performance) Persistent Disk ( pd-ssd ) Suitable for enterprise applications and high-performance databases that require lower latency and more IOPS than standard Persistent Disk provides.
